title: NCRPB Draft Regional Plan 2041 Approves 4 Greenfield 'Namo Cities' & 'PARIVARTAN' Scheme
summary: Proposes ₹5,000 crore central support for Namo Cities and ₹9,585 crore vehicle replacement scheme.

blocks.content: Proposes ₹5,000 crore central support for Namo Cities and ₹9,585 crore vehicle replacement scheme.

items: Namo Cities: 4 greenfield integrated urban hubs planned along RRTS corridors with ₹5,000 crore central assistance.
PARIVARTAN Scheme: Cabinet-approved ₹9,585 crore scheme to replace 2.07 lakh old BS-III/IV buses and trucks in Delhi-NCR.
30-Minute Transit: Integrated RRTS network aiming to reduce inter-city travel time across 55,083 sq km NCR to 30 minutes.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: NCR Planning Board chaired by Union Housing & Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Namo Cities central outlay (₹5,000 cr) vs PARIVARTAN vehicle replacement outlay (₹9,585 cr).
